messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service 'model-catalog-config' — severity: high. Symptom: surge in 5xx from inference gateway + tokenizer mismatch detected. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/PD789012

pagerduty: Incident PD789012 created · urgency: high · triggered by 5xx spike (>3% over 1m) from prod inference-gateway. Escalation target: eng-oncall SRE.

maya: ack — I'm on it, investigating logs and recent catalog promotions.

liam: saw surge ~03:12 UTC right after a catalog promotion. Customers on dedicated-prod seeing truncated/garbled outputs and some 429s behind retries.

sre_jordan: can we pin traffic back to the previous revision while we investigate? which rev was promoted?

maya: promoted rev = rev-2026-03-14-19, previous rev = rev-2026-03-13-22.

ops_elaine: initiating rollback/pin now: ```sh
# pin default to previous revision
redwoodctl catalog set-default --model-id gpt-family --rev rev-2026-03-13-22 --env prod
```

engremy: FYI need to flush KV/prefix caches for that model after pin to avoid cross-rev cache hits — running: ```sh
curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/flush-cache -d '{"model":"gpt-family","scope":"kv"}'
```

support-ana: CS flagged customers A and B with examples of corrupted token outputs (we have transcripts). They're asking for ETA.

maya: observability note: after promotion logs show repeated error: "tokenizer mismatch: expected bpe_v2, got bpe_v1" in model-runtime. Also increased tokenization failures correlate with 500s.

liam: that looks like metadata/manifest mapping got replaced during promotion — tokenizer key changed. We should disable auto-promote until we validate. @ops_elaine can you disable promotion?

ops_elaine: disabled promotion pipeline for prod and paused the promotion job. CI job flagged. 

sre_jordan: routing mitigation — adding compatibility fallback while we confirm rollback: ```sh
route apply --from model=gpt-family --to variant=compat-bpe-v1 --percent=100 --env prod
```

engremy: drafting status update for status.redwood: "We are investigating intermittent 5xx responses for model inference after a catalog promotion; mitigation (rollback) in progress. We will update in 15 minutes."

support-ana: sending customer notice to top 10 impacted and opening support threads.

maya: PD escalation window at +8m if not resolved.

liam: root cause hypothesis: promotion pipeline allowed catalog manifest with missing/incorrect tokenizer mapping to go live — new default tokenizers weren't validated against runtime compatibility.

engremy: can we add a quick preflight check? e.g., validate manifest tokenizers against running runtime tokenizers and fail promotion if mismatch. I'll open a hotfix PR, but need to stabilize first.

ops_elaine: rollback completed — traffic pinned to rev-2026-03-13-22. Early metrics: 5xx rate fell from 3.8% -> 0.2% within 2 minutes. KV flush completed.

incident-bot: PD789012 acknowledged by maya. No further escalation scheduled.

maya: running end-to-end sanity with customer sample prompts and monitoring logs for tokenizer errors.

support-ana: CS reported one customer confirmed immediate improvement and closing their support ticket.

sre_jordan: post-incident action items (tentative):
1) Add tokenizer compatibility check to promotion pipeline (prevent mismatched manifests).
2) Make catalog promotion transactional/atomic with ability to rollback automatically on tokenization/compatibility failures.
3) Add a lightweight canary step that verifies tokenization for a small % of traffic before full cutover.
4) Update on-call runbook with steps to pin/rollback and flush caches.

liam: I'll take #1 and #3 — aim to have PR + tests by EOD.

engremy: I'll own #4 and draft the runbook changes + a small CLI helper for quick pin/rollback.

ops_elaine: promotion job re-enabled in staging only with extra validation gates.

maya: marking incident as mitigated for now — will close PD in 10m if no regression. :white_check_mark:

liam: thanks everyone — great rapid response.

support-ana: I'll add customer impact notes to the incident record and attach transcripts.

maya: follow-up postmortem scheduled in #postmortems tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Will include timeline and artifacts.

sre_jordan: leaving a pointer to logs and the rollback commands in the incident doc.

maya: closing thread here once PD closed. Good job team.
